pattern.description: A click on the hovered task row selects it (row flashes blue), the panel blanks with a loading spinner, and the task's parameter form loads in a new tab while the cursor stays parked.
pattern.why_premium: The recording is trimmed so the click-to-load round trip takes about a fifth of a second, landing the new screen right on 'cloud and on-premises' so the demo feels instant.

build_hint.gsap: Timeline of instant steps: tl.set('.row.target', {backgroundColor: '#8fb8f5'}).set('.list-view', {autoAlpha: 0}, '+=0.13').set('.spinner', {autoAlpha: 1}).set('.spinner', {autoAlpha: 0}, '+=0.1').set(['.form-view', '.tab-new'], {autoAlpha: 1}); no easing, the cut is the motion.
build_hint.remotion: Use <Sequence> blocks: list view frames 0-4 (row highlighted from frame 1), blank panel with spinner frames 4-7, form view and new tab from frame 7; no interpolation, hard swaps at 30 fps.

notes: Screen-recorded navigation, mostly hard swaps rather than tweened motion. The blue click highlight on the list row exists only in pre-swap frames, so it has no end-frame box and is covered by b01. Cursor appears stationary across the event, so it is not listed.
